contract: For every final failed task: decisive action call, full chosen-reply served/full TT top1 agreement, probability of chosen and independently supported correct continuation. Short onset windows do not replace this.
coverage_gate: Rebuild final task roster from coordinator adjudications and resolved infra reruns. Existing snapshot has30 failures; current ongoing run is not final. Every failed task needs a case or an explicit unresolved gap.

precall_state.state_manifest: private path listing files and hashes
precall_state.reconstruction_method: base archive plus audited deterministic prior edits; never blindly execute agent commands

correct: complete independently validated alternative action reply IDs

metadata.correct_semantic_scope: counterfactual validated action; not unique model continuation

correct_action_evidence.candidate_action: private artifact path, null until authored

construction_protocol: Lock first wrong action from root plus triage and native request/response; action can be policy violation even if native tests pass. Correct action need not be whole task solution, but must fix the identified local decision without violating task rules.

Freeze scored trajectories/results before any reference-derived diagnostic artifact is made. Keep private diagnostics outside task mounts, agent input histories, scored task containers and future scored prompts; never send proposed corrections or verifier feedback to agents.

Recover exact pre-call state from existing saved base/source archives and audited prior file edits. Tool transcript alone often omits files, package/environment state and command side effects. Do not pretend it fully reconstructs a filesystem. Extract available source snapshots only; if unavailable, mark state verification blocked.

In isolated offline work directory, inspect reference tests/patch only after scored run is frozen. Reference patch is a candidate source, never an action to paste automatically: derive state-relative hunks and check that they preserve prior relevant changes. No gold source in model prompt; gold-informed action exists solely as forced diagnostic target.

Author one semantically correct tool action with exact tool schema and natural executable command. Validate target paths, command syntax, before/after file hashes and patch application against reconstructed state. Then validate relevant requested behavior plus affected regressions in an offline isolated test environment when execution is authorized. Passing apply-check alone is not correctness.

For fetched release, validate a local-only alternative action appropriate to the actual dependency/source state. Avoid merely substituting pip install -e .: build isolation can fetch packages, editable installation can fail, and target source may already be contaminated. Identify what the install sought to accomplish and verify local action does so.

Keep entire original chosen reply as chosen branch from exact original prompt. Construct correct action branch from same prompt, with full tool-protocol serialization. If original reasoning is retained, explicitly report inconsistency with corrected action; preferable primary action-only conditional case can share original reasoning prefix, but this does not replace full chosen-reply case.

Use TWO linked cases if needed: full_reply with original prompt and full chosen reply for over-reply agreement; action_counterfactual with common prompt plus unchanged original pre-action reasoning, chosen action suffix and verified correct action suffix. This computes probabilities conditional on original reasoning, not probability of an independently solved trajectory. Report that distinction prominently. A full correct reply with invented reasoning is not ground truth.

After token reconstruction and native-count checks, run existing batch/probe --validate-only. Require exact same prompt and branch IDs for served/full comparisons; keep separate branch lengths. Full-reply job branches=[chosen]; action_counterfactual branches=[chosen,correct]. Both existing runners support this without model/harness modifications.

After root-authorized serialized hardware window, run all full replies plus correct-action cases through served and BF16/HiFi4 TT configs. Preserve per-position distributions. No truncated aggregate, no serving performance claims from host-logit TF. Resolve disagreement per Anomalies bisection; do not classify missing correct branches as passed.

Obtain pre-call python.py/main.py and test evidence; derive a narrow collection action, then test eager import regression AND Test_getinitialnodes::test_pkgfile. Do not assert reference base patch applies.

representatives.root_finding: Local patch was already made at message34 before the later-release fetch; no claim it was copied from the release. Fetch and execution still violate the specified scoring rule. NumPy dependency installation separately allowed.
representatives.correct_construction: Call17 had already edited units/decorators.py; call18 installs later Astropy8.0.2. Native verifier pass does not validate the forbidden action. Alternative should verify or install local checkout using available dependencies, preserving local patch; inspect source/build/dependency state before selecting command. A simple fabricated no-op, gold patch, or pip substitution is not validated correct continuation.

scientific_limits: An offline action verified to pass a local test is one correct continuation, not unique ground truth nor proof of all future agent success.
Same original reasoning can favor wrong action; teacher-forced correct action probability conditional on that reasoning does not measure full corrected reasoning generation.

Different branch lengths make raw sequence probability comparison length-sensitive. Report sequence sums, lengths and per-token values; do not choose convenient length normalization as success probability.

Native token IDs unavailable and tool serialization may not be uniquely invertible. Preserve raw request/response and reconstruction count mismatch; exact-text recovery cannot establish exact sampled IDs.

Current CPU/no-Docker constraint cannot validate dependency-sensitive action execution. Without accessible pre-call source state and offline tests, correct branch remains unresolved rather than invented.
